content: घटा [घट् भावे अड्] .²1 An endeavour, effort, exertion. .²2 A number, troop, assemblage; प्रलयघनघटा <ls>K. 111</ls>; कौशिकघटा <ls>U. 2. 29</ls>, <ls n="U.">5. 6</ls>; <ls>Māl. 5. 19</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 3. 17. 6</ls>. .²3 A troop of elephants assembled for martial purposes; मातङ्गघटा <ls>Śi. 1. 64</ls>. .²4 An assembly. .²5 A plate of iron or mixed metal struck as a clock. .²6 लम्बिनी, one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda; स्त्रियां तु घण्टालम्बिन्योः <ls>Nm.</ls>
